violations.text:
No Heimlich maneuver/choking sign posted.
Emailed to operator

Silverware/utensils stored upright with the food-contact surface up.
Spoon next to 3 bay sink. Manager corrected

Required employee training expired for some employees. To order approved program food safety material, call DBPR contracted provider: Florida Restaurant and Lodging Association (SafeStaff) 866-372-7233.
Julie, Arturo

Employee beverage container on a food preparation table or over/next to clean equipment/utensils.
Drinks on prep table. Items were removed
Employee personal food not properly identified and segregated from food to be served to the public.

Records/documents for required employee training do not contain all of the required information.
The year is missing on Nancy and Ronald's food safety training. Manager looked up dates and added to certificates.
